proposals.before: Shu Lin, whose style was Fuzhai, belonged to the Gao clan and the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner; he was the son of Grand Secretary Gao Jin.
proposals.after: Shu Lin, whose style was Fuzhai, belonged to the Gaojia clan and the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner; he was the son of Grand Secretary Gao Jin.
proposals.reason: 高佳氏 is the clan name Gaojia, not a shortened Gao clan.

proposals.before: Shu Lin, style name Fuzhai, of the Gao clan, a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner, was the son of Grand Secretary Gao Jin.
proposals.after: Shu Lin, style name Fuzhai, of the Gaojia clan, a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner, was the son of Grand Secretary Gao Jin.
proposals.reason: 高佳氏 should be rendered Gaojia, matching the Manchu clan name in the Chinese.

proposals.before: With Li Shijie and Canal Director Li Fenghan he decided that of the four breach points, only Sijiazhuang and Tangjiazhuang should be used for diversion, and that blocking and repair work there must begin at once.
proposals.after: With Li Shijie and Canal Director Li Fenghan he decided that of the four breach points, only Sijiazhuang and Tangjiazhuang had a split current, and that blocking and repair work there must begin at once.
proposals.reason: 分溜 reports where the current had already split, not a plan to use those sites for diversion.

proposals.before: Together with Li Shijie and the canal director Li Fenghan he deliberated: there were four breach points, but only at Sijiazhuang and Tangjiazhuang should diversion be made, and work to block and build should be urgently undertaken;
proposals.after: Together with Li Shijie and the canal director Li Fenghan he deliberated: there were four breach points, but only at Sijiazhuang and Tangjiazhuang had the current split, and work to block and build should be urgently undertaken;
proposals.reason: 惟兩處分溜 describes split flow at those breaches, not an instruction to divert there.

proposals.before: In the fifth year he was transferred to Huguang to command the suppression of the Qing, Lan, and Huang White Lotus bands at Xiangyang.
proposals.after: In the fifth year he was transferred to Huguang to command the suppression of the Qing, Lan, and Huang numbered sect rebel bands at Xiangyang.
proposals.reason: 青、藍、黃三號教匪 are three numbered sect bands, not a group named Huang White Lotus.

proposals.before: He rose from a clerk in the Ministry of Works to censor, then served as Jiangxi's Jianan-Ganning circuit intendant and became Gansu surveillance commissioner.
proposals.after: He rose from a clerk in the Ministry of Works to censor, then served as Jiangxi's Ji-Nan-Gan-Ning circuit intendant and became Gansu surveillance commissioner.
proposals.reason: 吉南贛寧道 is the Ji'an–Nan'an–Ganzhou–Ningdu circuit; Jianan-Ganning is a mistranslation of 吉南.

proposals.before: From a principal clerk in the Ministry of Works he rose through censor, went out as Jiangxi Jianan-Ganning circuit intendant, and was transferred to Gansu provincial surveillance commissioner.
proposals.after: From a principal clerk in the Ministry of Works he rose through censor, went out as Jiangxi Ji-Nan-Gan-Ning circuit intendant, and was transferred to Gansu provincial surveillance commissioner.
proposals.reason: Same circuit-name error as the idiomatic line: 吉南 is Ji'an-Nan'an, not Jianan.

proposals.before: Early in Jiaqing he and Regional Commander Jilantai defeated sect rebels Zhang Yingxiang and Yang Tianzhu at Gongchang and Qinzhou, drove them to the Bailong River, and destroyed them.
proposals.after: Early in Jiaqing he and Regional Commander Jilantai defeated sect rebels Zhang Yingxiang and Yang Tianzhu at Gongchang and Qinzhou, drove them to the Baishui River, and destroyed them.
proposals.reason: 白水江 is the Baishui River, not the Bailong River (白龍江).

proposals.before: At the beginning of Jiaqing, together with regional commander Jilantai he attacked sect rebels Zhang Yingxiang and Yang Tianzhu at Gongchang and Qinzhou, advanced to press them at the Bailong River, and annihilated them.
proposals.after: At the beginning of Jiaqing, together with regional commander Jilantai he attacked sect rebels Zhang Yingxiang and Yang Tianzhu at Gongchang and Qinzhou, advanced to press them at the Baishui River, and annihilated them.
proposals.reason: Literal English also renders 白水江 as Bailong, which is a different river name.

proposals.before: In the sixtieth year he was made acting governor of Fujian and Zhejiang.
proposals.after: In the sixtieth year he was made acting governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.
proposals.reason: 署閩浙 continues the Two Guang governor-general posting and means acting Min-Zhe governor-general, not a provincial governor.

proposals.before: At Qingjiangpu Zhanglin heard that Anhui licentiate Bao Shichen knew river work. He visited Bao in person, inspected the estuary with him, found it was not high enough, and adopted his advice to drop the plan to change the channel.
proposals.after: At Qingjiangpu Zhanglin heard that Anhui licentiate Bao Shichen knew river work. He visited Bao in person, inspected the estuary with him, found it was in fact not elevated, and adopted his advice to drop the plan to change the channel.
proposals.reason: 實不高仰 means the estuary was not high/raised; 'not high enough' reverses the finding that justified abandoning a channel change.

proposals.before: Zhanglin reached Qingjiangpu, heard that Anhui licentiate Bao Shichen was versed in river affairs, visited him in person, together viewed the estuary, found it was in fact not high enough, and adopted his view to abandon the proposal to change the channel.
proposals.after: Zhanglin reached Qingjiangpu, heard that Anhui licentiate Bao Shichen was versed in river affairs, visited him in person, together viewed the estuary, found it was in fact not elevated, and adopted his view to abandon the proposal to change the channel.
proposals.reason: Same reversal of 不高仰 in the literal rendering.

proposals.before: In the fourteenth year, because treasury silver was stolen, his rank was inscribed and he was retained in office.
proposals.after: In the fourteenth year, because treasury silver was stolen, his rank was reduced and he was retained in office.
proposals.reason: 鐫秩 means to cut or reduce rank, not to inscribe rank; the idiomatic rendering already has this meaning.

proposals.before: He then took a single boat through Humen with only a dozen attendants. Bao led hundreds of ships, cannon thundering, surrounded the boat kneeling in welcome, pacified his men on the spot, and was allowed to memorialize begging mercy for his life.
proposals.after: He then took a single boat through Humen with only a dozen attendants. Bao led hundreds of ships, cannon thundering, and they surrounded the boat kneeling in welcome. He at once soothed the assembled followers and permitted a memorial begging that their lives be spared.
proposals.reason: The silent subject of 立撫其眾 and 許奏乞貸死 continues Bai Ling, who went out in the single boat; the idiomatic English wrongly assigns the pacification and the plea for mercy to Zhang Bao.

proposals.before: Hong Lake had flooded several years running; four of five dams had failed, and an edict ordered urgent repairs.
proposals.after: Hong Lake had flooded several years running; four of five dams had failed, and an edict rebuked him and ordered urgent repairs.
proposals.reason: Chinese 詔責急修 includes rebuke (責), which the literal English keeps and the idiomatic English drops.

proposals.before: In the tenth year, Kayin of Siam's dependency Gayaungla provoked trouble with Burma; he sought help from Menglian native chief Dao Paigong, who went to aid and was killed, losing his seal.
proposals.after: In the tenth year, Burma came into conflict with Gayaungla, a dependent barbarian of Siam; help was sought from Menglian native chief Dao Paigong, who went to aid and was killed, losing his seal.
proposals.reason: The literal English invents the name Kayin, which is not in 緬甸與暹羅屬夷戛於臘構釁.

proposals.before: In the twenty-second year the frontier tribesman Gao Luoyi beyond Lin'an called himself King of the Woni, set up a false government, gathered more than ten thousand followers, killed native officer Long Dingguo, raided the Wazha and Xichu chiefdoms, and crossed the river to threaten the interior. Bolin went in person and suppressed him.
proposals.after: In the twenty-second year the frontier tribesman Gao Luoyi beyond Lin'an called himself King of the Woni, falsely appointed offices, gathered more than ten thousand followers, killed native officer Long Dingguo, raided the Wazha and Xichu chiefdoms, and crossed the river to threaten the interior. Bolin went in person and suppressed him.
proposals.reason: 偽署官職 means he falsely appointed official posts, not that he set up a government as an institution.

proposals.before: In the twenty-third year Luoyi's nephew Gao Laowu fled beyond the Tengtiao River and rebelled again, troubling even the prefectural city.
proposals.after: In the twenty-third year Luoyi's collateral nephew Gao Laowu fled beyond the Tengtiao River and rebelled again, troubling even the prefectural city.
proposals.reason: 從侄 is a collateral nephew (cousin’s son), not an unmarked brother’s son.

proposals.before: Zhanglin and Fei Chun governed the Jiangnan region in turn, one strict and one lenient; each had his own strengths and weaknesses in talent and character.
proposals.after: Zhang Lin and Fei Chun governed the Jiangnan region in turn, one strict and one lenient; each had his own strengths and weaknesses in talent and character.
proposals.reason: 長麟 should be spaced Zhang Lin to match the chapter’s other two-syllable personal romanizations.

decisions.reason: 高佳氏 is the Manchu clan name Gaojia; shortening it to ‘Gao clan’ drops 佳 and misstates the lineage.
The literal line likewise renders 高佳氏 as ‘Gao clan’; Gaojia is the accurate clan name.
惟司家莊、湯家莊兩處分溜 reports that only those two of four breaches already had split flow, not that they should be used for diversion; 急興工堵築 is the repair decision.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 漫口有四，惟司家莊、湯家莊兩處分溜，急興工堵築

decisions.reason: 分溜 describes the existing split current at the two breaches, not an instruction that diversion ‘should be made’ there.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 惟司家莊、湯家莊兩處分溜

decisions.reason: 青、藍、黃三號教匪 are three numbered (Qing, Lan, Huang) sect rebel bands; ‘Huang White Lotus’ invents a name the Chinese does not give.
吉南贛寧道 abbreviates Ji’an, Nan’an, Ganzhou, and Ningdu; ‘Jianan-Ganning’ wrongly fuses 吉南 into one place-name.
The literal office title repeats the same error; Ji-Nan-Gan-Ning matches 吉南贛寧.
白水江 is the Baishui River; Bailong (白龍江) is a different hydronym not in this sentence.
The literal field also mistranslates 白水江 as Bailong; Baishui is the name given in the Chinese.
After 兩廣總督, 調署閩浙 is an acting Min-Zhe governor-generalship, not a provincial governorship.
實不高仰 finds that the estuary was in fact not raised; ‘not high enough’ reverses that finding and the reason for dropping 改道.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 同視海口，實不高仰，用其說罷改道之議

decisions.reason: The literal ‘not high enough’ likewise reverses 不高仰; ‘not elevated’ restores the inspection result.
鐫秩 means to reduce rank, not to inscribe it; the proposed literal matches 鐫秩留任 and the idiomatic line.
After 環船跪迓 the silent agent of 立撫其眾 and 許奏乞貸死 is Bai Ling, who went out in the single boat; the original wrongly gives those acts to Zhang Bao.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 遂單舸出虎門……環船跪迓，立撫其眾，許奏乞貸死

decisions.reason: 詔責急修 includes 責, a rebuke as well as an order to repair; omitting it drops part of the edict.
緬甸與暹羅屬夷戛於臘構釁 names no Kayin; Burma and the Siamese dependent barbarian Gayaungla came into conflict, and help was sought from Dao Paigong.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 緬甸與暹羅屬夷戛於臘構釁，求助於孟連土司刀派功

decisions.reason: 偽署官職 is illicit conferral of official posts, not setting up a government as an institution.
從侄 marks a collateral nephew, not an unmarked 侄 (brother’s son); the proposed kinship term restores 從.
長麟 is already correctly identified; respacing Zhanglin as Zhang Lin is a romanization-style preference, not a semantic error, and the chapter’s other lines already use Zhanglin.

claimRevisions.reason: The edict is 詔責急修: the emperor both rebuked and ordered urgent repair, so the extracted action cannot remain ‘ordered-urgent-repair’ alone.
